x: Cooper and Stinton who were first and second for the school in the high jump are also members of our club and so it can be seen that although we lost the match, our club members were well to the fore.

Cooper and Stinton gained useful points in the high jump and Stinton was also third in the long jump. We were beaten by S.L.H. in the medley relay and the final scores were: S.L.H., 36 points; Belgrave, 33 points; Cambridge, 28 points.
In the field events, Charlie Melchoir was second in the Javelin and third in the Shot Putt. Young Stinton did 5 ft. 6 ins. in the High Jump Final match scores were: Belgrave H., 57 points; Met.
